description: This file contains a report module for production analytics in the manufacturing module of ERPNext, generating data and charts related to work order statuses over periods.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns, data, and chart for production analytics report.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates report columns based on date ranges.

methods.name: get_periodic_data
methods.description: Aggregates work order data into status-based periods.

methods.name: update_periodic_data
methods.description: Updates the count of work orders for a given status and period.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches work order entries and prepares data and chart for the report.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares chart dataset from periodic data.
